## Workload

Chloe Mensah completed 494 reads during the quarter, recording 402 hours of work. This represents a rate of 1.2 reads per hour. The workload was managed within the existing session pattern, which the grader and reviewer agreed to maintain.

## Quality

A total of 45 reads were checked as part of the review. Agreement between the original and review assessments was 82.2 per cent. The result provides a clear measure of consistency across the work completed during the quarter and supports continuation of the current approach.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
